battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A protected-target death, missing arrival or saturated central lane rejects the candidate regardless of later kills.

Upper and lower arts casters remain alive.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward, Durin, GALLUS and Lava attack the artillery during their actual coverage windows. Require its ENEMY_DEATH by frame 3600; neither roadblock damage nor retiring a threatened caster discharges this duty.
Plume and GALLUS clear eastern upper [1,6] before frame 1890. Midnight later clears western upper [1,2]. Record the first civilian's safe arrival.
Melantha clears eastern lower [6,6]; Popukar clears western lower [6,2]. Account for officer attacks while the civilian waits upstream, then record its safe arrival.
Fang owns upper central blocking. GALLUS supplies opening damage; Steward supplies permanent arts damage, including armored-enemy clearance.
Vanilla owns lower central blocking. Both professional medics cover it. Durin returns before the final runner pairs to clear armored enemies and prevent block saturation.
Plume owns the opening; Midnight owns subsequent outer officers. The vacancy after Plume's retirement is permitted only after opening kills are confirmed.
Friston hands living interception to Popukar at frame 3000. Melantha temporarily intercepts upstream while clearing the eastern roadblock.

Permanent lower outer interception and western lower roadblock clearance.
Permanent upper outer interception and western upper roadblock clearance.
Eastern lower roadblock clearance and temporary upstream officer interception.

formation_structure.artillery_clearance_status: UNPROVEN. No complete 13000-HP damage budget has been established for these placements. Destruction by frame 3600 is a required hypothesis, not a demonstrated result.
formation_structure.artillery_geometry: Steward and Lava occupy upper tiles two columns apart. Ansel and Durin are adjacent lower targets, so their shared splash exposure requires actual healing evidence, especially during the lower artillery pass.
formation_structure.capacity: The nominal formation never exceeds eight simultaneously deployed operators, even when counting robots conservatively.

economy.balance_scope: These lower bounds exclude refunds from Lancet, GALLUS, Durin, Friston and Lava. No unsupported talent income, charger kill income or refund from a death is budgeted.
economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural 1 DP/s, Fang effective initial cost 10, observed Fang grants and legal Vanilla activations. Vanilla's immediate skill DP is a current-model rule.
critical_dependencies: Fang must survive to produce the grants used before frames 1380, 2550 and 3000.
Vanilla activations at 750, 1650 and 2550 must be legal and produce their supported grants.
Plume's successful living retreat must return 5 DP before Durin's frame-1950 deployment.
economy.failure_semantics: Missing income or a dead predecessor is a survival or handoff failure. The remaining timeline does not repair it automatically.

formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel DOWN [5,6] covers Fang [3,5], Vanilla [4,5], Steward [2,5], Lava [2,7] and Durin [5,7]. Hibiscus RIGHT [5,3] covers Friston/Popukar [6,3], Vanilla [4,5], Ansel [5,6] and Melantha [6,5]. Lancet LEFT [2,5] covers Fang and Plume.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla establish central control before runners arrive. Plume and Friston then establish the outer interceptions. Ansel enters at 32 seconds and Hibiscus at 46 seconds, rather than depending on a late replacement refund to restore survival.

formation_transitions.transition: Ansel assumes continuous central treatment before the dangerous artillery passes; verify HEAL events rather than proximity.
Hibiscus assumes lower outer treatment before Friston's opening survival margin expires.
Withdraw living Lancet before Steward occupies its tile.
Withdraw living Plume only after the eastern upper roadblock is destroyed and its opening hostiles are cleared. This creates an intentional outer-lane vacancy before the 111-second officer spawn.
Withdraw GALLUS before replacing it with Lava at 2550. Do not treat retirement as evidence that its roadblock duty succeeded.
Withdraw Durin, then replace living Friston with Popukar on the identical tile. Require immediate interception of every released hostile.
Withdraw living Lava before further upper exposure. Existing projectiles retain their locked locations.
Midnight restores upper outer interception before the modeled 111-second officer reaches [1,5].
Melantha assumes eastern lower clearance and intercepts approaching officers upstream of Popukar.
Withdraw Melantha after eastern lower destruction and release are observed; Popukar remains the lower outer interception owner.
Redeploy Durin after a 71-second cooldown buffer. It becomes permanent lower central arts support.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Use only listed normal-mode rarity-1–3 operators. Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and a cardinal direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Every hostile must retain an interception or demonstrated kill-before-exit obligation. Same-tile replacement requires observed BLOCK continuity, not merely legal deployment.
Verify actual treatment of Vanilla, Friston and artillery targets. Coverage alone does not establish healing allocation or survival.
Count all occupants of each locked blast area. Retreat neither relocates a projectile nor makes its old tile safe for a successor.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians; ordinary medics do not heal them. Roadblock destruction, officer exposure and safe arrival must be observed separately.
Credit income and refunds only after their living-source conditions succeed. A missing grant or refund invalidates the dependent handoff.
Require actual artillery destruction by frame 3600. The proposed caster schedule has an unclosed damage-budget obligation and cannot be reported as verified feasible.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Establish four interceptions, fund early treatment and keep both vanguards alive.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: An opening death or missing heal invalidates later income and interception assumptions.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Clear eastern upper, preserve central control through splash, and establish caster output.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A stalled eastern upper civilian or unhealed central blocker defeats the protection structure.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Complete the lower living handoff, restore upper outer blocking and destroy artillery.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Artillery survival leaves both civilian exposure and eventual zero-leak clearance unresolved.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Finish the remaining roadblocks, verify both safe arrivals and restore lower central arts.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: A protected-target death or unresolved lower armor queue rejects the candidate.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Hold four lanes through the last runner pairs and armored spawns.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Block saturation or any leak rejects acceptance.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Maintain blocking, healing and arts until every remaining hostile is dead.
pressure_window_responsibilities.failure_consequence: Elapsed time and exhausted spawns alone do not establish WIN.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic supported income only. Grants remain conditional on Fang being alive and deployed.
Manual income and ATK. Each cycle includes ten active seconds and twenty inactive seconds.
Hold first readiness from frame 1710 for the lower artillery pass. Subsequent cycles include twenty-five active and thirty-five inactive seconds. Range extension later reaches Midnight [1,5].
Supported healing amplification; baseline treatment must preserve the opening until first readiness.
Deployment SP plus ten inactive seconds permits activation. Credit attack speed and actual individual hits, not unsupported splash geometry.
Arts conversion and ATK accelerate western upper clearance and later officer kills. Do not assume melee attacks can target the flying artillery.
Use supported automatic enhanced hits. Do not assume highest-defense targeting.
Use base stats and ordinary modeled attacks. No mitigation, resistance reduction, dodge or unsupported stat talents are credited.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Replace the late defender-refund chain with two early income vanguards and professional healing at frames 960 and 1380. Ansel covers both central interceptions; Hibiscus sustains the lower outer interception and Ansel. Plume and GALLUS jointly clear the eastern upper roadblock before Plume withdraws. Concentrate successive casters on artillery exposure windows, then establish permanent outer blockers that also clear the western roadblocks. This is an unexecuted full-stage candidate; artillery destruction and continuous healing remain explicit verification obligations.

revised_stage_understanding.GameData_facts: Four roadblocks obstruct the two neutral civilians. Their destruction is a separate obligation from hostile interception. Civilian death costs objective life; safe arrival does not.
UNKNOWN: Exact client target ordering, timing and build equivalence.
Actual healing allocation and caster survival under this new formation.
Whether the proposed artillery exposure windows deliver the required 13000 HP of damage.
Exact roadblock destruction and civilian arrival frames under competing hostile targets.
revised_stage_understanding.current_model_rules: Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians, and ordinary medics heal deployed operators. Artillery projectiles retain fixed impact positions after creation. Range coverage does not determine which injured unit receives treatment.
revised_stage_understanding.revision: The opening now funds professional treatment earlier through two supported vanguards. Beagle's endangered position and its conditional replacement-refund chain are removed rather than retimed.
revised_stage_understanding.validation_scope: Only read-only source inspection, range checks and conditional DP arithmetic were performed. No simulation was run.
revised_stage_understanding.verified_history_used: The archived Popukar handoff succeeded, while Beagle later died under insufficient treatment and released the first leaking officer. Both civilians subsequently died to artillery.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Two early income vanguards can fund continuous professional healing before the opening artillery pressure, allowing the four interceptions to survive while combined blocker and caster attacks clear roadblocks. Successive caster exposure windows may then destroy artillery early enough for the remaining civilian releases and final armored waves.
revised_strategic_hypotheses.support: Supported income, range geometry and the archived distinction between deployment legality and actual interception.
unclosed_obligations: Continuous healing and survival during shared splash.
Eastern upper destruction before Plume's withdrawal.
A complete artillery damage budget and observed destruction by frame 3600.
Both civilian arrivals and final armored-queue clearance.

revised_tactical_requirements.clearance_evidence: Require artillery death by frame 3600 and permanent arts support for both central armored-enemy queues.
revised_tactical_requirements.interpretation: This candidate is not certified feasible. A missing survival, clearance or funding dependency rejects the proposed structure; it must not be relabeled an arithmetic or command-emission success.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening_evidence: Require actual central treatment beginning at frame 960 and lower outer treatment after frame 1380, with uninterrupted BLOCK ownership.
revised_tactical_requirements.protection_evidence: Require device destruction, released civilian movement, bounded officer exposure and two safe-arrival events.

changed_responsibilities: Vanilla replaces Beagle as the lower central opening owner and receives Ansel treatment from 32 seconds.
Hibiscus enters at 46 seconds to sustain Friston and the medical formation.
Plume and GALLUS jointly own eastern upper destruction before Plume's retirement.
Popukar's later handoff requires living predecessor continuity and an observed BLOCK.
Midnight and Melantha add explicit roadblock clearance duties rather than relying on civilian treatment.
Caster output must establish actual artillery destruction; command legality and roadblock damage do not satisfy clearance.
revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Reject the opening medical hypothesis. Inspect Vanilla's survival, Ansel's actual coverage and selected healing target; do not credit deployment success or spend later conditional income as though continuous treatment had been established.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Replacing the late Beagle replacement economy with Fang plus Vanilla should fund earlier actual treatment, while preserving four independent interceptions and assigning roadblock damage to units that also own combat duties. Artillery destruction remains an unproven full-stage obligation.
